text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall — elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (service: inference-gateway). 5xx rate = 12% over 3m, threshold 3%. Alert ID: ALRT-1758.
ryan_sre: I'm on call, looking now. Any recent deploys?
lena_runtime: no deploys in the last hour from runtime teams. I can pull logs.
ops_lead: seeing lots of upstream 429s from quota-service in gateway logs, could be related.
amanda_cs: we have 4 customers reporting timeouts in EU region. They say requests just fail with a gateway error.
ryan_sre: ok capturing traces -> `curl -s http://monitoring.internal/api/alerts/ALRT-1758` gave spike in 502/504 traces hitting gateway-proxy -> upstream responses 429 from rate-limiter.
lena_runtime: grabbing a sample of gateway logs: ```
2025-06-12T14:12:03Z gateway ERROR upstream_status=429 upstream_service=quota-service request_id=rc3-abc
2025-06-12T14:12:03Z gateway ERROR failed to stream response to client: io.netty.channel.ConnectTimeoutException
```
ops_lead: same in rate-limiter metrics dashboard — quota-service returning bursts of 429s across many zones since 14:10 UTC. Throughput looks lower, causing backlog and connection timeouts downstream.
ryan_sre: any config changes to quota-service in the last deploy window? Check config management.
lena_runtime: I see a config push at 14:05 from configbot by `luca_engops` — policy: `default_global_qps=10` for `standard-tier` (was 1000). Who approved that?
maria_sre: wait that's huge — 10 qps global would cause massive 429s. Could be a mistaken unit. Opening config UI: https://config.internal/policies/standard-tier (link)
ryan_sre: rolling back to previous policy now. Command: `configctl rollback --policy standard-tier --to 2025-06-12T13:50:00Z`
deploy-bot: rollback job started: job_id=rb-4521. ETA ~ 45s.
incident-bot: Noted mitigation in progress. Continue monitoring 5xx and 429 rates.
lena_runtime: after rollback started, quota-service logs show policy reloaded. new effective qps=1000 at 14:14:18Z.
ops_lead: gateway 429s dropping quickly. 5xx rate falling from 12% -> 2.1% in last 2m.
amanda_cs: customers reporting recovery (Amanda: ticket #CS-8823). Sending customer update: "We identified quota misconfiguration causing throttling; fix rolling now."
ryan_sre: I'm going to scale up gateway replicas temporarily to clear backlog: `kubectl scale deploy gateway-proxy --replicas=8 -n prod`
lena_runtime: scaled. Also increasing connection pool to quota-service to 200.
maria_sre: good call. We're seeing latency tail drop. Start of impact window ~14:09 UTC, peak at 14:12, mitigated by 14:15 after rollback and scaling.
ryan_sre: I'll collect evidence for postmortem: config change log, rollback timestamp, graphs (5xx, 429, latency), affected customers list.
lena_runtime: exporting gateway logs and rate-limiter traces now to `/var/backups/incidents/1758001123/` (s3://redwood-incident-logs/1758001123/).
ops_lead: root cause: misapplied quota policy (human error / unit confusion in config UI). Secondary: lack of guardrails on global default change without canary.
amanda_cs: we opened CS tickets for the 4 impacted customers and sent a recovery note. One customer lost a short production batch; ops to follow up.
ryan_sre: handing off to maria for postmortem and follow-up actions, I'll remain available if anything pops. Summary for handoff:
- Incident start: 2025-06-12T14:09:12Z (first 429s)
- Peak 5xx: 2025-06-12T14:12:03Z (5xx=12%)
- Mitigation: rollback config at 14:14:18Z, scaled gateway at 14:14:35Z
- Recovery: 14:15:45Z (5xx < 3%)
- Impact: ~23 minutes total, 4 customers reported errors, some requests lost.
maria_sre: thanks — taking over. I'll draft the incident timeline and postmortem. Immediate actions: 1) block global default edits without a canary flag, 2) add validation to disallow unit-less QPS under 100, 3) add config change approval step for global policies.
lena_runtime: I'll open PRs for validation (#PR-6789) and add an automated canary rollout path to configctl.
ops_lead: SRE follow-ups: run a runbook to verify no residual rate-limit queues, increase retention on error traces for 24h.
amanda_cs: I'll send a personalized follow-up to impacted customers with root cause and steps taken.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Creating incident record INCD-1758001123 and paging postmortem channel.
ryan_sre: thanks team. Leaving the channel — will join postmortem meeting at 18:00 UTC if needed. :thumbsup:
maria_sre: noted. @amanda_cs please attach customer impact details into the incident doc. I'll run the RCA and include timeline and action owners.
amanda_cs: adding notes to INCD-1758001123 and linking CS-8823.
deploy-bot: rollback job rb-4521 completed successfully at 14:14:18Z.
maria_sre: closing handoff. If anything else flares, ping me and I'll escalate to platform eng.
ryan_sre: resolved. Good catch on config logs.
